capability.summary: Attempt to build one GraphQL SDL schema and structurally report success or caught GraphQLError syntax/build failures
capability.description: Reads an existing UTF-8 SDL file and attempts `graphql.build_schema`. A successful build returns non-introspection type-map names; a caught GraphQLError returns valid=false and exits 1. Other build failures such as TypeError from SDL semantic validation are not caught and produce a traceback instead of the structured validity result.
capability.problem_space: Best-effort local graphql-core schema build with structured success and GraphQLError reporting; not comprehensive SDL semantic validity checking because TypeError and other exceptions escape, and not query validation, remote endpoint inspection, resolver testing, or schema execution.

constraint.io_signature: Input: one required existing UTF-8 GraphQL SDL file; output: JSON with valid=true plus type_count/types, or valid=false plus a GraphQLError string.
accepted_inputs: an existing UTF-8 text file containing GraphQL Schema Definition Language accepted by graphql-core build_schema
constraint.output_shape: Valid schema: {status: "success", tool: "graphql-core", target: string, valid: true, type_count: integer, types: string[]}; types contains every schema.type_map key not beginning `__`. Caught GraphQLError: {status: "success", tool: "graphql-core", target: string, valid: false, error: string}, followed by exit 1. Non-existing path: {status: "error", message: string} and exit 2. Missing argument prints usage to stderr and exits 1 without JSON. File open/UTF-8 decoding errors and non-GraphQLError exceptions are uncaught and may produce a traceback.
limitations: only GraphQLError is caught around build_schema; SDL semantic validation failures raised as TypeError or other exception classes produce an unstructured traceback, so this is not a comprehensive SDL validity validator
does not validate GraphQL query or mutation documents, variables, resolver implementations, directive runtime behavior, or server responses
does not perform remote introspection, federation composition, schema diffing, formatting, code generation, or file modification
the returned type list excludes only names beginning `__` and can include built-in scalar or schema-support types, not solely caller-declared business types
reads the entire file with UTF-8 and has no explicit timeout, size limit, or output truncation

output_contract.description: JSON GraphQL SDL build result with valid/type metadata or a caught GraphQLError; the schema file is not modified.

json_schema.description: Native JSON representation only; no field or task-delivery guarantee.

intent_tags: attempt to build GraphQL SDL and report caught GraphQLError failures
